# Reveal Header Groups theme switches from the click position

## Context

After merging #20638, the operator requested a follow-up for the expanding circular reveal when changing the Header Groups theme. The polished example already switches between both skins; this adds the motion used by Workstation and Portal.

## The Problem

At the merged example source, `examples/grid/headerGroups/MainContainer.mjs:91–94` changes `theme` and synchronizes the button directly. It does not start a view transition, so the theme changes without the circular reveal.

This is required 13.4 release scope. The operator clarified: “no, this is not staying out. trivial change, big impact.” The release cut waits for the circular reveal.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: n/a — a requested visual enhancement; the existing instantaneous switch is functional.

- `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs#toggleWorkspaceTheme` and `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs#onSwitchTheme` pass the event's raw `clientX/clientY`, `windowId`, and `delay: 100` to `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition`, await that start, then apply the theme.
- `src/main/DomAccess.mjs#startViewTransition` resolves when capture has started, not when the reveal finishes. The caller changes the theme inside the capture window.
- `src/main/DomUtils.mjs#createRevealAnimation` owns circle geometry and snapshot compositing. Missing coordinates skip the custom circle; an unsupported browser returns `false`. The caller still applies the theme, including when the remote round trip rejects.
- The current Issues example also switches directly. Workstation and Portal are the verified reveal call-site precedents.

Prescription checked: the Header Groups handler owns opting into the existing capability. A real-browser falsifier additionally showed that the current `DomAccess.startViewTransition()` resolves before the native update callback begins: the theme was already dark at callback entry and both snapshot layers were dark. Vega independently reviewed the three callers and agreed to fold the minimal capture handshake into this ticket. The promise must resolve at native update-callback entry (old snapshot captured), before the existing delay expires; it must not await `transition.ready` or completion. No new animation primitive is needed.

## The Fix

Accept the click event in `MainContainer#onThemeButtonClick`. Reuse the guarded Workstation/Portal sequence: await transition start with raw coordinates and this window's ID, then apply the existing theme change and button synchronization. Keep the palette, grid identity, geometry and proxy styling unchanged.

Correct `src/main/DomAccess.mjs#startViewTransition` to acknowledge old-state capture at native callback entry. Preserve reveal/animate wiring and settle unsupported, synchronous-start-failure and terminal-before-callback paths without hanging the caller. Do not add an app-side sleep or arbitrary timeout that reopens the race. Update the repeated timing explanation in Workstation. Add a deferred-native-callback unit pin and retain the Header Groups old/new snapshot pixel falsifier.

Cover the call shape, ordering and fallback in an example-scoped test; extend the existing browser evidence in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderGroupsTheme.spec.mjs` for the rendered reveal. Inspect `ViewTransitionReveal.spec.mjs` and the Portal controller unit spec as testing precedents. Observe actual browser capability rather than assuming a particular headless/headed mode supports or lacks it.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DomAccess.startViewTransition` capture boundary | Owning JSDoc and all three awaited call sites | Resolve after old-state capture, before the caller's existing delay window ends | `false` on unsupported/start failure or terminal completion before callback; no arbitrary early success | DomAccess + Workstation timing comments | Deferred-callback unit test and real-browser snapshot colors |
| Header Groups theme button | Existing handler; Workstation and Portal call sites | Circular reveal starts at the pointer, then the theme/button update within the capture window | Theme still changes with no API, no coordinates, or rejected decorative round trip | Handler JSDoc | Ordering/fallback checks plus real-browser both-direction visual receipt |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clicking the theme button in either direction visibly reveals the new skin from that click's position in a supporting browser; retain a mid-transition visual receipt, not only the final colors.
- [ ] The transition-start request carries the correct `windowId` and raw coordinates. The engine promise remains unresolved until native update-callback entry, resolves while the delay is still pending, and the old theme is observed at callback entry in both directions.
- [ ] Missing coordinates, an unsupported View Transition API, and a rejected remote call still change the theme and button state without an exception.
- [ ] Existing theme/gesture checks pass: the grid is not recreated, geometry is unchanged, and leaf/group proxies retain the selected skin.

## Out of Scope

Changing the shared reveal geometry, duration/easing policy or compositor; migrating other demos beyond the Workstation timing comment; broad example-catalog work; reopening the landed #20638 scope.

## Avoided Traps

Do not compute clip paths or device-pixel-ratio corrections in the App worker. Do not change the theme before the old snapshot is captured. Do not make a failed decorative animation disable theme switching. Do not add app CSS that fights the engine's old/new snapshot compositing; the closed `#17739`, `#18125`, `#18130` and `#18136` records explain those failures.
